name: io.github.fliptheweb/yazio-mcp
description: MCP server for accessing Yazio user & nutrition data (unofficial)

environmentVariables.description: Client id of the Yazio app (optional, a built-in default is used)
environmentVariables.name: YAZIO_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Client secret of the Yazio app (optional, a built-in default is used)
environmentVariables.name: YAZIO_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: User agent of a Yazio app build, e.g. YAZIO/26.41.2 (com.yazio.android; build:610090905; Android 36) Ktor. Sent only to the API versions that check it (v20 and later); no current call needs it (optional)
environmentVariables.name: YAZIO_USER_AGENT
